The system checks every few hours. You might see a level change anytime — but never during a call. Your ongoing call always finishes at the rate it started.
No. Your level stays. If you stop calling, you stay at your current level. If your performance drops, you go down only one level at a time. Hard work compounds.
What if I switch to a different language?
Your level stays the same when you switch languages. No reset, no change.
How do I withdraw my earnings?
Bank transfer. Weekly auto-payout, or on-demand once you reach ₹50 minimum. TDS applies only if you cross ₹1,00,000/year (10% with PAN, 20% without PAN).
